resources.string:
How to use the keypad:

• Tap the small round button to open the keypad. Drag it anywhere on the screen; its position is remembered.
• 0–9: type a channel number (the TV page switches after a short pause).
• CH ▲ / CH ▼: move up / down in the channel list.
• OK: play the highlighted item.
• ✕: close the keypad. It also closes by itself after a few seconds.
• ⓘ: opens this About page.
• Phone Back key: closes the keypad, then goes back in the page, then exits.

The screen follows how you hold the phone (portrait or landscape), even when rotation lock is on.
